question: Paraná Governor Election Winner
resolution_criteria:
The Paraná gubernatorial election is scheduled to take place in Brazil on October 4, 2026, with a runoff on October 25, 2026, if no candidate receives a majority of the valid votes in the first round.

This market will resolve according to the candidate who wins this election.

Temporary, interim, or placeholder governors appointed by any means before the specified election will not be considered.

If the result of this election isn't known by June 30, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, the market will resolve to "Other".

This market will resolve based on the result of the election, as indicated by a consensus of credible reporting. If there is ambiguity, this market will resolve based solely on the official results as reported by the Brazilian government, specifically the Superior Electoral Court (Tribunal Superior Eleitoral, TSE) (e.g., www.tse.jus.br/eleicoes/resultados-eleicoes).

"Other" means any option not listed here.
research:
## Paraná Governor 2026: research summary as of 2026-09-24

**Main finding:** Sergio Moro (PL) leads every poll I found. Of the listed options, only Moro, Requião Filho and Sandro Alex appear in the polls I saw.

### 1. Resolution source
- The criteria point to official TSE results (www.tse.jus.br/eleicoes/resultados-eleicoes). The first round is 2026-10-04, so no results existed on 2026-09-24. I did not fetch the TSE page because there was nothing to show yet.
- A search turned up articles dated October 2026. They are after the cutoff, so I ignored them.

### 2. Current status
- Nothing had settled the race by 2026-09-24. Moro was the clear poll leader. The open question was whether he would clear 50% of valid votes and win outright, or face a runoff on 2026-10-25.
- Which listed names are actually running for governor, based on the poll ballots:
  - **Running:** Moro (PL), Requião Filho (PDT) and Sandro Alex (PSD, Governor Ratinho Jr.'s chosen successor). The minor candidates are Luiz França, Tayná Miessa, Alexandre Salomão, Samuel de Mattos and Adriano Funileiro.
  - **Not on the governor ballot:** Alexandre Curi is running for the Senate (Republicans party). Rafael Greca, Guto Silva and Beto Richa do not appear on any September ballot. [Brasil de Fato](https://www.brasildefato.com.br/2026/09/04/pesquisa-mostra-moro-na-lideranca-ao-governo-do-parana-mas-analista-aponta-teto-de-crescimento/)
- 2026-08-12/13: Sandro Alex's PSD coalition asked the regional electoral court (TRE-PR) to reject Moro's registration because no government plan was filed. Moro's team said the law allowed documents to be added until Aug 15. Moro was still on the ballot in the September polls, but I could not confirm the court's ruling directly. [DGABC](https://www.dgabc.com.br/Noticia/4340820/psd-do-parana-pede-indeferimento-de-candidatura-de-moro-por-falta-de-plano-de-governo)

### 3. Recent news (newest first)
- **2026-09-24, Quaest** (fieldwork Sep 20-23, PR-02802/2026):
  - First round: Moro 36%, Requião Filho 20%, Sandro Alex 20%, the other candidates 1% or less, blank/null 9%, undecided 12%. My estimate of Moro's share of valid votes is about 46%.
  - Runoffs: Moro 48 vs Requião 32; Moro 43 vs Sandro 29; Sandro 38 vs Requião 32.
  - [Gazeta do Povo](https://www.gazetadopovo.com.br/eleicoes/2026/pesquisa-eleitoral-2026/quaest-governador-parana-setembro-2026/)
- **2026-09-22, IRG** (fieldwork Sep 17-20, 1,200 interviews): Moro-Vasconcelos ticket 39.7%, Requião Filho-Caputo 21.3% (from the search summary). The TRE-PR later suspended this poll at the request of Moro's own coalition, and Gazeta took the figures down. That page update is dated after the cutoff. [Gazeta do Povo](https://www.gazetadopovo.com.br/eleicoes/2026/pesquisa-eleitoral-2026/irg-pesquisas-governador-parana-setembro-2026-2/)
- **2026-09-18, Paraná Pesquisas** (fieldwork Sep 15-17, 1,280 interviews, margin of error ±2.8):
  - Moro 44.7%, Requião 23%, Sandro Alex 19.7%, none/blank/null 5.8%, don't know 4.8%.
  - My calculation puts Moro at about 50% of valid votes, right at the threshold for a first-round win. [Gazeta do Povo](https://www.gazetadopovo.com.br/eleicoes/2026/pesquisa-eleitoral-2026/parana-pesquisas-governador-parana-setembro-2026-2/)
- **2026-09-04, Paraná Pesquisas** (fieldwork Aug 31-Sep 2):
  - Prompted ballot: Moro 45%, Requião 24%, Sandro Alex 17.5%.
  - Unprompted: Moro 24.2%, Requião 10.2%, Sandro 6.3%.
  - Analyst Emerson Cervi says Moro has a floor of about 40% but possibly a low ceiling, and that Sandro Alex was not yet widely known as Ratinho Jr.'s candidate. [Brasil de Fato](https://www.brasildefato.com.br/2026/09/04/pesquisa-mostra-moro-na-lideranca-ao-governo-do-parana-mas-analista-aponta-teto-de-crescimento/)
- **July 2026 and earlier:** Moro led every scenario the outlets reported. [Poder360](https://www.poder360.com.br/poder-eleicoes/moro-lidera-com-folga-a-disputa-ao-governo-do-pr-diz-pesquisa/), [O Povo](https://mais.opovo.com.br/jornal/politica/2026/07/28/sergio-moro-lidera-para-o-governo-do-parana.html)

### 4. Base rates
- 2022: Ratinho Jr. was re-elected in the first round with about 70% of valid votes. 2018: Ratinho Jr. also won in the first round. Paraná has tended to settle governor races in round one, but in both cases the winner was the incumbent or the government-backed candidate. [Wikipedia 2022](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2022_Paran%C3%A1_gubernatorial_election)
- In 2022, Moro won Paraná's Senate seat with 33.5% of valid votes.
- In Brazilian state races, a candidate leading by 15 or more points in late-September polls usually wins. The key uncertainty here is round one versus a runoff, not who leads.

### 5. Other forecasts
- **Polymarket** ("Paraná Governor Election Winner", launched 2026-06-09): one snapshot shows Moro 84%, Requião Filho 11%, Rafael Greca 3.3%, Guto Silva 2.9%, with about $17.5K in volume. Another snapshot shows Moro at 77%, and a June analysis put him at 82%. The snapshot dates are unclear and liquidity is low. [Polymarket](https://polymarket.com/event/parana-governor-election-winner-20260608205118343), [Predscope](https://predscope.com/event/parana-governor-election-winner-20260608205118343)
- I found no Kalshi or Manifold market and no formal expert model.

### 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- The final week of campaigning: TV debates, last polls (Quaest, Paraná Pesquisas, possibly others) and any further TRE-PR rulings on polls or registrations.
- 2026-10-04: first round. Moro needs more than 50% of valid votes to win outright. Recent valid-vote estimates are about 46% (Quaest) and about 50% (Paraná Pesquisas).
- 2026-10-25: runoff if needed. Quaest has Moro ahead in every head-to-head, by 14 to 16 points.
- The deciding swing factor is whether Ratinho Jr.'s machine lifts Sandro Alex into second place and consolidates the anti-Moro vote.
